newsitem.title: USA: IMC Global executes supplemental indentures.
newsitem.headline: IMC Global executes supplemental indentures.

text.p: IMC Global Inc said Friday that supplemental indentures relating to its 9-1/4 percent senior notes due 2000 and 10-1/8 percent senior notes and Series B senior notes due 2001 were executed by the company and trustee.

The company said it was informed that at the close of business September 5 about $46.2 million of the 9-1/4 percent notes, $48.4 million of the 10-1/8 percent notes and $18.9 million of the 10-3/4 percent Series B senior notes due 2003 had been validly tendered in connection with the tender offers and contingent consolicitations for these notes.

The amounts tendered represent about 75 percent of the 9-1/2 percent notes, 78 percent of the 10-1/8 percent notes and 35 percent of the principal amount of the 10-3/4 percent notes outstanding on July 25, 1996.
As previously reported, IMC Global expects to reduce future interest expense by financing the tendered notes at lower rates under the company's credit facility and money market lines.
